summary: A Yes vote continues the town's paramedic services special tax, with proceeds placed in a special fund used solely for paramedic and pre-hospital emergency services.

tax.text: A Yes vote extends and increases property taxes to fund paramedic services.
tax.quote: The other seven jurisdictions are seeking up to $107.50 per dwelling or 1,000 square feet of developed nonresidential property, with increases of up to $4 a year.

tax.text: A No vote does not approve the proposed tax extension and increase for paramedic services.
